Welcome to The Arcticathon by Bidaya!

  • A solo online hackathon where you’ll take an idea from a blank screen to a working, deployed website all on your own. 

About The Arcticathon:

  • The Arcticathon is a student-focused online hackathon by Bidaya, built around the theme of the Arctic.
  • You can create almost anything that runs in a browser: a web app, interactive experience, game, tool, or something completely different. Your project should connect meaningfully to the Arctic theme and showcase your creativity, technical skills, and problem-solving.
  • This is a solo-only hackathon. You’ll be the designer, developer, and project manager of your own project.

‍ What You Need to Build:

Requirements:

  • Make at least three pages that link to each other
  • Make a nested route
  • Use at least 5 components
  • One of those components should accept children
  • One of those components should accept props
  • Have a nested component
  • Create a component that fetches and displays data from an API (e.g. JSONPlaceholder)
  • Log 3 hours using hackatime
  • Note: Your submission needs to be meaningful (eg. a portfolio, or a website showcasing your favourite artists) and also use relevant APIs (eg. using a Dummy posts API for a blog page instead of using a lorem ipsum API).

️ Important Rules:

  • AI tools are not allowed. This includes AI code generation, AI design tools, AI writing tools, and AI coding assistants. AI usage can make your project ineligible for prizes.
  • Your work must be your own. Plagiarism, copying another participant's project, or misrepresenting authorship will result in disqualification.
  • To be eligible for prizes, participants must also log at least 3 hours of coding time through Hackatime.

How Projects Are Judged:

Projects will be reviewed based on:

  • Creativity
  • Technical execution
  • How well the project connects to the Arctic theme

Every submission will be reviewed by the judging team.

Submission:

Before the deadline, participants must submit:

  • A live link to their website
  • Their public GitHub repository
  • An optional 60-second video explaining their project
  • The submission deadline is strict, so make sure your project is deployed and submitted on time.

Build solo. Explore the Arctic. Ship something real.

prizes.others: $100,000 Total Prize Pool, Every participant will receive funding toward purchasing a domain for their project, with the total value of domain funding distributed across eligible participants. Participants can use their allocation to register a domain and take their project online.
Special Certificate + Bidaya Trebuchet Placement Priority.
